answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 32166 Country: India Title: Interest @ Insurance Question: Imam saheb mujhe ek insurance company main computer operator ka kaam mila hai. Mera kaam ye hai key joy admi insurance karaya hai uska pura details main computer main load karta hoon. Ye kaam karna Quran Aur Hadith main jayez hai. pls batayai. Answer ID: 32166 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1030/648/H=1432) It is allowable if you have not to save the dealing of interest and gambling in saving the complete details. It is mentioned in hadith: Hadhrat Jabir said that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) cursed those who receive interest and those who pay it and those who record it and bear witness to it. (Muslim Sharif) You should adopt the job keeping this hadith in mind. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
